title: Incarnate
summary: INC'ARNATE, verb transitive [Latin incarno; in and caro, flesh.] To clothe with flesh; to embody in flesh. INC'ARNATE, adjective Invested with flesh; embodied in flesh; a the incarnate Son of God. 1.
